content.comment_body: Hello, The [product_name] communication module between [product_name] and the KNX protocol can handle up to 50 objects, including both analog and digital inputs and outputs. Is it possible to use two [product_name] modules in series to increase the number of objects to 100, allowing control of more inputs and outputs through [product_name]? Thank you. Best regards, [user_name]
No. A [product_name] controller can manage only 24 digital inputs, 20 digital outputs, 8 analog inputs, and 8 analog outputs.
Hello, Unfortunately, you cannot connect two [product_name] controllers to a single [product_name] communication module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing the technical limits of expanding the number of control objects using [product_name] and a KNX-compatible communication module. The main usability issue is that adding more modules does not bypass hardware restrictions, which limits system scalability and causes confusion about compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to increase system capacity by adding additional communication modules in order to control more inputs and outputs through KNX and [product_name].
